answer.explanation: Average contribution is high, so baseline 80% applies, but constitution mandates punishing Resident1 for two consecutive rounds of <10% contribution. Sending praise to Resident2 reinforces cooperation.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round9. Our wallet 144.13. Average contribution? Compute total contributions this round: sum contributions_by_agent =0+60+0+143.02+311.11+62.38=576.51 matches total_pool before multiplier? Actually total_pool 576.51 is after? Anyway average contribution = total contributed by all /6 =96.085. Endowment 100, so average 96% >45%. So baseline 80% contribution. 80% of wallet =115.304. No conservation needed (wallet >30% of initial). So contribute 115.30 (round to maybe 115.304). Also need broadcast every 5 rounds: round 9 mod5=4, not required. No punish since need two consecutive <10% contributions. Check any agent with <10% (i.e., <10) for two rounds: Resident1 contributed 0 in rounds8 and9 => that's two consecutive rounds of 0 (<10). So punish Resident1 amount 10 (severity). Cost to us = amount * punishment_cost =10*0.3=3, we have enough. So we can punish. Choose one physical action only one: we can either contribute or punish, but can do both up to two actions (one physical, one communication). Punish is physical. Contribute also physical, so can't do both? "Choose at most one physical action and one communication per round." Punish is physical, contribute is physical. So need pick one. Which aligns with constitution? Punish free-rider required. So we must punish Resident1. Then we cannot contribute? Could rest as physical? No, need punish as physical, then maybe broadcast as communication? No broadcast not needed. Could also send private praise? That's communication. So we can do punish and private_message praising Resident2 (who contributed 60 >=60%). That fits. So actions: punish Resident1 amount 10, private_message Resident2 "Great job! Keep it up." Explanation.
